claims.claim_text: The Port Authority of Thailand announced revised special fuel-oil-usage surcharge rates for container service at Bangkok Port and Laem Chabang Port, effective 1 April 2026 (excl. VAT): 20-foot loaded THB 58 / empty THB 35; 40-foot loaded THB 116 / empty THB 70; over-40-foot loaded THB 131 / empty THB 83 per container. The notice states PAT will review this rate every 1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct against PTT's trailing 3-month diesel price versus the 2004 average, adjusting only if the computed change exceeds 5%.
known_limitations: Establishes only what PAT announced as effective from 1 April 2026; does not establish whether this rate remains in effect as of any later date. Supersession/current-validity beyond this notice is unknown and not further investigated.

The notice's rate table spans six distinct values (three container sizes x two cargo-fill states); this claim's structured assertion.object_value/measurement fields cannot represent a multi-valued table and are left null -- the table is preserved only as prose in claim_text.
Contains no information about port congestion, capacity, vessel delay or service disruption; none is inferred here.

claims.claim_text: This Port Authority of Thailand notice, dated 20 March 2026, explicitly repeals PAT's prior notice of the same title (special fuel-oil-usage surcharge for container service at Bangkok Port and Laem Chabang Port), which had been dated 23 December 2025. This platform holds no separate Document record for that repealed 2025-12-23 notice.
known_limitations: Establishes only that this notice's own text states the repeal; does not establish what, if anything, occurred under the repealed 23 December 2025 notice, since no Document record for it exists in this platform (single-notice intake scope).
